item.title: Trump Greenland envoy disinvited from dog sled race amid heightened rhetoric
item.description: President Donald Trump’s Greenland envoy, Gov. Jeff Landry (R-La.), was disinvited from the territory’s annual dogsled race amid White House rhetoric encouraging the annexation of the self-governing Danish territory.

item.title: Road closure on County Road 95 N
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- In Dothan Tuesday, January 20 County Road 95 N is closed to traffic between US Hwy 84E and Boat Landing Road until further notice, according to Houston County.

item.title: Alabama Department of Commerce reports job growth
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Governor Kay Ivey announced Tuesday that Alabama saw record job and business growth in 2025. The Alabama Department of Commerce's annual report lists 234 new projects started in 2025 that combined for a total capital investment of $14.6 billion and 9,388 new job commitments. item.title: WATCH: ICE removes citizen from Minnesota home in his underwear after warrantless search

item.title: Alabama bill will make path for veterans to become teachers

item.title: Fire breaks out in Geneva hemp plant
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) — A large hemp plant in Geneva caught fire Monday night. The fire started at Samson Extracts along West Magnolia Avenue sometime before 10:30 p.m. Law enforcement sources tell WDHN that the fire started in the ceiling in an area of the manufacturing plant believed to contain barrels of highly flammable chemicals.
